git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix: record auto-reply misconfiguration in p.Error, correct escapeYAMLPipe trust claim

Copilot review on PR #257 found two issues:

- pipeline.go's auto-reply config guards (invalid args, unregistered
  runner) logged at Error but left p.Error empty, so a permanent
  misconfiguration produced a completed-pipeline record indistinguishable
  from success. Only the transient runner.Run failure set p.Error. Both
  guards now set p.Error with the underlying cause.
- escapeYAMLPipe's doc comment claimed both call sites carry "trusted
  content," but stageContext's output (prior-stage results and planner
  args) is not signature-verified, unlike Command.Prompt. Narrowed the
  trust claim to the Prompt call site only.
EOF
)"
